Title: Generally available: Rich text editor in Microsoft Purview data catalog

Body.Content:
Rich text editor in Microsoft Purview enables you to add rich formatting to asset or term descriptions such as adding bolding, underlining, or italicizing text. You can also create tables, bulleted lists, or hyperlinks to external resources.

Learn more by reading the Microsoft Purview documentation.
